## Summary
What does this change do, and why?

## Type of change
- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] Hardware / electrical
- [ ] Mechanical
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / project

## Affected module(s)
Which module(s) does this touch? Does it preserve module independence
(no lateral coupling — see docs/Firmware Architecture.md)?

## Related issues
Closes #

## Checklist
- [ ] Builds cleanly (`pio run`)
- [ ] Tests pass / added where relevant (`pio test`)
- [ ] Public interfaces documented in the relevant header
- [ ] `src/hardware.h`, `docs/Wiring.md`, and BOM kept consistent (if pins/parts changed)
- [ ] `docs/Revision History.md` updated (for hardware/mechanical/milestone changes)
- [ ] Commit messages follow the CONTRIBUTING.md style
- [ ] No secrets or local config committed

## Notes for reviewers
Anything specific you'd like feedback on.
